annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 90/486/EEC of 17 September 1990 amending Directive 84/529/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to electrically operated lifts
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 90/486/EEC of 17 September 1990 amending Directive 84/529/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to electrically operated lifts
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 270
annotation.summary_en: 1990 Council Directive extending Directive 84/529/EEC on lifts to cover hydraulic and oil-electric lifts, referencing CEN standards EN 81-1 and EN 81-2 to remove trade barriers in the internal market. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends Directive 84/529/EEC scope to hydraulic and oil-electric lifts
Annex I references CEN standards EN 81-1 and EN 81-2
Member States must transpose within six months of notification
Aims to remove technical barriers to intra-Community trade
